css: .rtl{direction:rtl;unicode-bidi:plaintext} .big{font-weight:900;color:#fff;line-height:.92;letter-spacing:-2px;padding:30px 50px;text-shadow:0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35)} .or{color:#E8693C} .chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:14px 28px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:34px;color:#fff;background:rgba(18,18,20,.72);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.18),0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.3);margin:24px} .pad{padding:30px} .card{background:rgba(16,16,18,.86);border-radius:36px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.12),0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.45);color:#fff} .lab{font-size:24px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:3px;color:#E8693C} .tag{position:relative;background:#F4EFE6;color:#0F0F11;border-radius:22px 22px 22px 22px;padding:26px 54px 26px 90px;font-weight:900;font-size:76px;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.4);margin:40px;transform:rotate(-5deg)} .tag:before{content:'';position:absolute;left:30px;top:50%;width:26px;height:26px;margin-top:-13px;border-radius:50%;background:#0F0F11;opacity:.85} .stamp{display:inline-block;border:8px solid #E8693C;color:#E8693C;font-weight:900;font-size:64px;padding:8px 36px;border-radius:18px;transform:rotate(-8deg);margin:40px;background:rgba(244,239,230,.08)} .tape{display:inline-block;background:#F4EFE6;color:#0F0F11;font-weight:900;font-size:72px;padding:6px 34px 10px;margin:30px;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35)} .step{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px;margin:0} .num{width:78px;height:78px;border-radius:39px;background:#E8693C;color:#0F0F11;font-weight:900;font-size:42px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none} .stx{font-size:50px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap}
